notes.title: New Update for Techbrawlogy: Into the RoboDome
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed players occasionally being offcenter in the victory screen.
[*]Fixed music resetting to 0 volume when quitting to the main menu from a match.
[*]Fixed game black-screening when cancelling prompt to quit to main menu, then quitting to main menu afterwards.
[*]Fixed players remaining locked on to phase 1 enemies after the Boss cutscene.
[*]Fixed players regaining health if they manage to level up while downed.
[*]Fixed players remaining downed for a brief period of time after being revived.
[*]Fixed Goliaths being able to rapidly spam sidesteps back to back.
[*]Fixed players being able to be registered as downed while still alive.
[*]Reworked player animation trees to resolve some animation/movement hitches.
[*]Removed Big Clunkus
[/list]
